summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K announcing that the European Medicines Agency has accepted a submission to update the label for its Bexsero meningococcal B vaccine. The update proposes a single-dose booster for individuals aged 10 years and older previously vaccinated with Bexsero. The filing is a routine operational announcement regarding regulatory progress for a product label update. There are no financial terms, board recommendations, or structural changes. No special situation or corporate transaction is involved. This is a standard current report of a foreign private issuer on clinical-stage regulatory activity.
